{{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable) |ability1 = '''Summon''' - Summons in two [[Snow Minion]]s and a 1 delay between each spawn. |ability1_cooldown = 15 }} ==Description== The '''Blizzard Wizard''', internally referred to as '''Frost Acolyte''', is a summoner enemy that appears in the [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. It has a high amount of health and a average speed. It has the [[Stun Immunity]] and [[Freeze Immunity]], making it immune to being fully stopped by stuns, fully immune to knockback and fully immune to freeze. It has one ability, where it summons in two [[Snow Minion]]s. ==Appearance== The '''Blizzard Wizard''' is a creature with blue skin. It has no legs and instead floats above the ground. It wears a grey robe with blue accents and a hood. On its arms, it wears grey bands with blue crystals on them. It also has a black belt. It carries a blue staff with its right arm, which it uses to summon in [[Snow Minion]]s. ==Strategy== *DPS towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]] can be useful against it due to its high health, though early-game towers like the [[Golden Scout]] can still be effective against it. *Switching your towers' targeting to ''Last Enemy'' is recommended because of its ability, which can summon in hordes of [[Snow Minion]]s if not killed quickly. **Usually due to their health, having one or two towers set to that is enough. *As the '''Blizzard Wizard''' has the [[Stun Immunity]] and [[Freeze Immunity]], it cannot be stunned, knocked back or frozen. **Any stuns will only slow it down. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFrostAcolyte.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (3 December 2025 - Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} FrostModeThumbnail.png|'''Blizzard Wizard''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} WinterEvent2025PromoImage.png|'''Blizzard Wizard''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Valentines Crate 2026 - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Blizzard Wizard''' on a promotional video. Pulse Trooper Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Blizzard Wizard''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} DefaultEnemyIconIG.png|'''Blizzard Wizard''' on its bugged [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Blizzard Wizard''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''3 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]] **'''Frost Acolyte''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Frost Acolyte''' has a broken icon. **{{Bug}} '''Frost Acolyte's''' model does not load in the [[Index]]. **{{Bug}} Throwing a [[Flash Bang]] at a '''Frost Acolyte''' while it is summoning enemies breaks the enemy, making it stop moving. *'''19 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0|v1.82.2]]a **{{Bugfix}} '''Frost Acolyte's''' model now loads in the [[Index]]. *'''28 January 2026''' - [[v1.84.0]] **Health increased from 3,600 to 4,750. **Cash given increased from {{Money|4,750}} to {{Money|5,000}} on death. **Size increased. **[[Health Regen]] removed. **[[Freeze Immunity]] removed. **[[Stun Immunity]] added. **''Summon'' ability changed. ***Now summons two [[Snow Minion]]s with [[Health Regen]] with a 0.75 delay between each spawn. ***No longer summons a [[Bloated]] [[Frostbane|Permafrost]]. ***Cooldown decreased from 18 to 16. *'''28 August 2026''' - [[v2.8.0]] **First wave appearance chamged from 19 to 23. **Name changed from ''Frost Acolyte'' to ''Blizzard Wizard''. **Health decreased from 4,750 to 3,000. **Cash given decreased from {{Money|5,000}} to {{Money|2,250}} on death. **Speed increased from Below Average (2.8) to Average (3.3). **[[Freeze Immunity]] added. **''Summon'' ability changed. ***The [[Snow Minion]]s spawned no longer gain [[Health Regen]]. ***Spawn delay increased from 0.75 to 1. ***Cooldown decreased from 16 to 15. **Size slightly decreased. {{FrostMode|[[Frost Undead]]|Wave 21|Blizzard Wizard|Wave 23|[[Frost Hunter]]|Wave 25}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Mid-Game]]
